name: swimlane-mcp
description: See your KanbanFlow tasks, or a teammate's, across all your boards. Read-only.
long_description:
Ask Claude things like "What do I have in progress?" or "What is Laura working on?". Swimlane reads your KanbanFlow boards and never changes them.

You need one API token per board: in KanbanFlow, open the board menu > Settings > API & Webhooks and create a token.

Unofficial project, not affiliated with KanbanFlow.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Lists the tasks of a person (you by default) on every configured board.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Finds tasks whose name, description, labels or subtasks contain a text.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Shows one task in full, including its description, people and comments.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Finds recent comments, including the ones that mention you.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: Shows the configured boards: columns, colors and members.

kanbanflow_api_keys.title: KanbanFlow API tokens
kanbanflow_api_keys.description: One token per board. To use several boards, separate them with commas. Get them in KanbanFlow: board menu > Settings > API & Webhooks. / Un token por tablero, separados por comas.

kanbanflow_user.title: Your KanbanFlow email
kanbanflow_user.description: The email you use in KanbanFlow, so Claude knows which tasks are yours. / El email con el que entras en KanbanFlow.
